title: BEST CREEPER FARM in Minecraft Bedrock, MCPE, Consoles 1.21!
description:
In this video, I will show you how to make the next generation of the creeper farm in Minecraft Bedrock. Not just this farm, it doesn't need a Trident system, and it works based on fall damage with a new pattern giving the best result in terms of spawning rate. It also fixes the most common problem in creeper farms. We finally found the problem that caused a low rate for mobile players in Minecraft!

If you enjoyed this channel, it will focus on high-performance and simple farms that are beyond levels of bedrock, so be sure to turn on the notification to be notified!
